evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/q/b wraps one java.net.Socket plus its InputStream/OutputStream, exposes synchronous reads and queues writes through a circular byte buffer serviced by its Runnable writer thread.
Client constructs rs/q/b directly from the live game Socket during login/connection setup and retains it as the active network connection wrapper.

The class preserves legacy 317 RSSocket fingerprints including 'Error closing stream', 'Error in writer thread', EOF handling, circular writer-buffer overflow logic and the same Runnable writer architecture.
Public 317 client sources identify this exact Socket/InputStream/OutputStream/Runnable structure and error-string set as RSSocket.

candidates.note: Original legacy 317 RSSocket identity recovered from exact network behavior and retained source fingerprints.
